So target SMILES would be same as precursor but with C(=O)O changed to C=O. Let's construct target SMILES by taking one of the precursor SMILES and replacing the carboxylic acid with aldehyde. The template applied to that target yields the three precursor pairs (different silylation sites). The template likely is "protect alcohol with silyl chloride". Because the target has free OH groups (the aldehyde has no OH, but there are other OH groups in the molecule: the O in the ring maybe? The target has an OH at O[Si]? Plus "Cl[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" as separate reagent.

Thus mapped_rxn could be "[O:1]>>[O:1][Si:2]([C:3])([C:4])([C:5])". Template ID unknown.
